summary: One P2 empty-URI finding blocks upstream; fork validation allowed.

findings.title: Empty explicit source URI now emits an invalid empty SF record
findings.trigger: Source.newBuilder(language, "ROOT(STATEMENT)", "same-name").uri(URI.create("")).buildLiteral() is accepted and has null path.
findings.impact: Candidate emits SF: with no identifier. LCOV 2.0-1 skips the record and exits 1 with no valid records, even when existing unrelated format warnings are ignored. Baseline emits SF:null and summary succeeds with one source and one covered line. This regresses usable summary data to discarded data for a supported source input.
findings.requestedChange: Refine the specification to require a non-empty SF identifier, choose a deterministic non-empty fallback for an empty URI, and add a regression test. The existing non-null URI contract does not guarantee a non-empty URI string.

coverage.independence: initial.json was written after source/diff inspection and before evidence.json or raw logs were read.
coverage.specification: Normal path and non-empty URI cases satisfy the requested rule; blanket URI fallback needs an empty-URI exception. Distinct default-URI contents retain distinct identifiers in an actual LCOV summary.
coverage.correctness: Source.getURI guarantees non-null. Candidate bytecode confirms the null-path fallback. File-backed source with an explicit conflicting URI still emits the path.
coverage.negativeCases: Executed empty URI, shared explicit URI, pathless file URI pointing to existing file, path with explicit override URI, and same-name different-content default literals.
coverage.regressions: Confirmed empty-URI record loss versus built baseline using identical probe; file-path behavior remains intact.
coverage.consumerCompatibility: LCOV 2.0-1 summary retains two default URI sources with --ignore-errors format. genhtml cannot resolve synthetic or file-scheme URI strings as source paths; file-path control renders successfully with the same format-warning option.
coverage.dependencies: No new library dependency or exported API. Uses existing Source API and Java URI. No source changes or builds performed.
coverage.tests: Supplied 8-test candidate success and baseline 2 failures agree with logs. Tests assert SF strings, not consumer behavior; empty URI is absent.

limitations: Used existing built candidate and baseline distributions; verified changed method bytecode but did not rebuild or independently establish provenance for every dependency.
Did not rerun mx JUnit/checkstyle; no concurrent mx builds or source modifications.
Consumer checks cover Linux LCOV/genhtml 2.0-1 only, not editor extensions or Windows.
No exhaustive hash-collision or encoding analysis of pre-existing default URI algorithm.
Temporary source files and generated HTML were removed after execution; durable probe, trace files, commands, and logs are retained.
No PR, push, deployment, external-provider request, delegated reviewer, billing metadata, or pipeline-adapter receipt created.
